_readme: Which AI answers each task. Providers are tried in the order listed: free tiers first, paid OpenAI last. A provider is skipped when its key is not set up (enabled=false), when its free daily limit is used up, or when the task contains personal data and the provider is a free tier (free tiers may use data for training). Model names and free limits change often: check them on each provider's site before relying on them. Keep in sync with the ROUTING object in workflows/src/gateway-router.js.

gemini.get_key: aistudio.google.com > Get API key (no card needed for the free tier)

openrouter.get_key: openrouter.ai > Keys. Then pick a model whose id ends in ':free' and put it below, and set enabled=true

T3._note: High-impact decisions (product approval, money) use a strong paid model only. Add a second paid provider later for independent review.

rules: Try providers in chain order; move to the next only on an error (rate limit, quota, outage, invalid answer). Never call a second provider after one succeeded (prevents duplicate actions).
Tasks with contains_personal_data=true skip free tiers.
Free daily_limit values are kept slightly under each provider's published limit; verify them on the provider's site.
Paid calls are checked against budget.json caps before sending. If every provider is unavailable or over budget: stop and ask the owner on Telegram.
